name: Amazon ECS
description: AWS container orchestration service for deploying, managing, and scaling Docker containers without needing to manage the underlying cluster software.

name: Amazon EKS
description: Managed service for running Kubernetes clusters on AWS without needing to install and operate the Kubernetes control plane.

name: Ansible
description: Agentless automation tool that uses YAML-based playbooks to handle configuration management, application deployment, and orchestration tasks.

name: Apache Ant
description: Java-based build automation tool that uses XML configuration files to define tasks for compiling, testing, and packaging software projects.

name: AWS CDK
description: Framework that lets developers define cloud infrastructure using familiar programming languages, which is then synthesized into CloudFormation templates for deployment.

name: AWS CloudFormation
description: AWS service for provisioning and managing cloud resources using declarative JSON or YAML templates, enabling infrastructure as code.

name: Azure Container Apps
description: Serverless hosting service on Azure for running containerized applications and microservices without managing underlying infrastructure or orchestration directly.

name: Azure DevOps
description: Microsoft suite of cloud services for software development teams, bundling source control, CI/CD pipelines, work item tracking, and artifact management.

name: Azure Pipelines
description: CI/CD service within Azure DevOps that automates building, testing, and deploying applications across multiple platforms and languages.

name: Azure Resource Manager Templates
description: JSON-based declarative templates used to define and deploy Azure resources in a consistent, repeatable way.

name: Bicep
description: Domain-specific language for deploying Azure resources declaratively, offering simpler syntax than raw ARM JSON templates while compiling down to them.

name: Bitbucket
description: Git repository hosting platform from Atlassian that supports code collaboration, pull requests, and built-in CI/CD pipelines, often paired with Jira.

name: BrowserStack
description: Cloud-based platform that lets teams test websites and mobile apps on real browsers and devices without maintaining local device labs.

name: CloudBees
description: Company offering enterprise DevOps and software delivery automation products, including managed Jenkins and CI/CD platforms for large organizations.

name: Concourse
description: Open-source continuous integration and delivery system that models workflows as pipelines of containerized tasks and resources.

name: Docker
description: Platform for building, packaging, and running applications in lightweight, portable containers that bundle code and dependencies together.

name: Docker Compose
description: Tool for defining and running multi-container Docker applications using a single YAML configuration file to specify services, networks, and volumes.

name: Fastlane
description: Open-source toolset for automating the build, testing, and release process of iOS and Android mobile applications.

name: Git
description: Distributed version control system used to track changes in source code and coordinate collaborative software development across teams.

name: GitHub
description: Web-based hosting service for Git repositories that provides tools for code collaboration, pull requests, issue tracking, and project management.

name: GitHub Actions
description: CI/CD feature built into GitHub that lets teams define automated workflows for building, testing, and deploying code triggered by repository events.

name: GitLab
description: Web-based DevOps platform combining Git repository hosting with issue tracking, CI/CD, and project management in a single application.

name: GitLab CI/CD
description: Built-in continuous integration and deployment feature of GitLab that automates pipelines for building, testing, and releasing code.

name: GoCD
description: Open-source continuous delivery server designed for modeling complex build and deployment pipelines with dependency tracking and visualization.

name: Gulp
description: JavaScript-based task runner used to automate repetitive front-end development tasks such as minification, compilation, and file watching.

name: Helm
description: Package manager for Kubernetes that uses charts to define, install, and upgrade complex applications and their dependencies.

name: Jenkins
description: Open-source automation server used to build continuous integration and delivery pipelines, extensible through a large plugin ecosystem.

name: JFrog Artifactory
description: Universal binary repository manager for storing, versioning, and distributing build artifacts and dependencies across many package formats.

name: Kubernetes
description: Open-source platform for automating the deployment, scaling, and management of containerized applications across clusters of machines.

name: Make
description: Build automation tool that reads Makefiles describing dependencies between files to compile and link programs efficiently.

name: Microsoft Hyper-V
description: Native hypervisor built into Windows for creating and managing virtual machines, enabling multiple operating systems to run on a single physical host.

name: Newman
description: Command-line tool for running and automating Postman API test collections, often used in CI pipelines for API testing.

name: Octopus Deploy
description: Deployment automation tool that manages application releases and orchestrates deployments across multiple environments and servers.

name: OpenShift
description: Enterprise Kubernetes platform from Red Hat that adds developer and operational tooling on top of Kubernetes for building and deploying containerized applications.

name: Packer
description: Tool for creating identical machine images for multiple platforms (cloud, virtualization, containers) from a single source configuration.

name: Pulumi
description: Infrastructure as code platform that lets teams define and manage cloud resources using general-purpose programming languages instead of a dedicated DSL.

name: Puppet
description: Configuration management tool that uses a declarative language to automate the provisioning, configuration, and maintenance of infrastructure at scale.

name: Team Foundation Server
description: Microsoft's on-premises application lifecycle management platform providing source control, build automation, and work item tracking, later rebranded as Azure DevOps Server.

name: TeamCity
description: CI/CD server from JetBrains used to automate building, testing, and deploying software projects.

name: Terraform
description: Infrastructure as code tool that uses a declarative configuration language to provision and manage resources across many cloud and on-premises providers.

name: Visual Studio App Center
description: Cloud-based service from Microsoft for building, testing, distributing, and monitoring mobile and desktop applications throughout their lifecycle.
